limitations: Historical holdouts were consumed for diagnosis; fresh seed43 adds only two synthetic tasks.
One seed/split per comparison; no statistical or global ranking claim.
Wall-time search paths and LLM context/cache can vary even with fixed seeds.
Local Qwen9B and short2CPU runs differ from platform8CPU/32GB/3h.
Label separation is by evaluator/input contract, not an adversarial OS sandbox.
Internal CV, meta/calibration scores and external final-CSV scores are distinct.
Ollama server memory is excluded from agent tree RSS.
Unknown provider usage is conservatively reserved by the host; not actual billing.

publication_maintenance.change: After all measurements, update only the default Universal revision from8188bfc to1dd19b5; final runs used explicit --universal-ref. Algorithms, scorer and normalization are unchanged.
